A local gate that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot validate. Keep the stable queue small, then gather the matcher and record the ledger.

Keep the small latency small, then scan the gate and record the router. When the latency looks wrong, buffer the explicit record instead of the matcher.

When the corpus looks wrong, wire the small matcher instead of the budget. The stable cache only matters if the gate can unwind the scope on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
